data.name: CPB_001
data.value: You have climbed the Celestial Altar...[pause=20] Few ever reach these heights.

data.name: CPB_002
data.value: I am the Warden of the Skies.[pause=15] I have kept the air in balance since the beginning.

data.name: CPB_003
data.value: A tremor rises from the earth to my tower.[pause=20] I will cleanse whatever carries it.

data.name: CPB_004
data.value: Enough...[pause=25] You stood your ground.[pause=15] This was never hatred, only duty.

data.name: CPB_005
data.value: That light in your eyes...[pause=20] I have seen it before, long ago.

data.name: CPB_006
data.value: Two travellers from elsewhere stood where you stand.[pause=20] They faced me too.

data.name: CPB_007
data.value: They asked me to strike down the star falling on this world.[pause=15] I did.

data.name: CPB_008
data.value: The ones from the old tales?[pause=15] We thought the storytellers made them up.

data.name: CPB_009
data.value: They were real.[pause=20] And you carry the same stubbornness they did.

data.name: CPB_010
data.value: Look at the sky![pause=20] Something is falling...[pause=15] and it is no shooting star!

data.name: CPB_011
data.value: The tremor below has stirred an old fragment.[pause=20] It returns to finish its fall.

data.name: CPB_012
data.value: As long as I watch over this sky,[pause=15] the earth will not burn a second time.

data.name: CPB_013
data.value: Rayquaza tears away from the altar and climbs straight into the upper sky.

data.name: CPB_014
data.value: A shaft of light splits the sky.[pause=15] The fragment breaks into a rain of shards.

data.name: CPB_015
data.value: He did it![pause=15] Look at all those shards...[pause=10] like a shower of stars.

data.name: CPB_016
data.value: But that purple glow...[pause=20] the whole valley must have seen it from below.

data.name: CPB_017
data.value: Go back down quickly.[pause=20] Those below only saw a burning sky.[pause=15] They will want someone to blame.

data.name: CPB_R01
data.value: The altar is bare.[pause=20] The wind crosses it without meeting anything.

data.name: CPB_R02
data.value: (He filled the whole sky.[pause=15] Now the sky is just... sky.)

data.name: CPB_R03
data.value: He went back to the upper atmosphere, I think.[pause=20] Wardens don't stay where they've been understood.

data.name: CPB_R04
data.value: Nothing more to find here.[pause=0] Time to head home.

data.name: CPF_001
data.value: Open up![pause=15] The Federation demands answers, right now!

data.name: CPF_002
data.value: The sky caught fire directly above you.[pause=20] No one else was up there.

data.name: CPF_003
data.value: They will not listen.[pause=20] They have already decided what happened.

data.name: CPF_004
data.value: (We stopped the worst of it...[pause=20] and they have come for us.)

data.name: CPF_005
data.value: Through the back door.[pause=15] Quickly, before they circle the building.

data.name: CPF_006
data.value: The rain will cover our tracks.[pause=20] Stay close and do not stop.

data.name: CPF_007
data.value: (The guild is falling away behind us.[pause=20] I do not know if we will see it again.)

data.name: CPF_008
data.value: The south road is still open.[pause=15] After that, we will need a boat.

data.name: CPF_009
data.value: That night, two explorers left Metano Town in the rain, and did not look back.
